goal: Stop the six regenerable pmcro-*.zip build artifacts from showing up as untracked in git status at the repo root, without touching anything else that's currently tracked or untracked.

steps.action: Create a root .gitignore that ignores the plugin build zips by exact name (pmcro-trail.zip, pmcro-orchestrator.zip, pmcro-planner.zip, pmcro-maker.zip, pmcro-checker.zip, pmcro-reflector.zip), not a broad *.zip wildcard, so any future non-build zip added deliberately isn't silently hidden from git status.

success_criteria: git status --short no longer lists any of the six pmcro-*.zip files as untracked (?? entries)
No previously-tracked file changes state (git status shows no new M or D entries for anything other than the new .gitignore itself)
The .gitignore is itself added and committed, so the ignore rule persists for future sessions
out_of_scope: Ignoring anything other than these six known build-artifact filenames
Changing how or where New-PluginZip.ps1 writes its output
Retroactively removing the zips from git history (they were never committed, per this session's earlier git status checks)
